docs.title: Documentation from the repo
docs.text: This minimal site demonstrates Part 1 Demo 2: Markdown in docs/ becomes a published site via MkDocs.

docs.title: Live demo
docs.text:
1. Open docs/what-we-ship.md and add one sentence about your team.
  2. Run mkdocs serve from the demos/doc-publishing directory (see repo README).
  3. Refresh the browser — docs stayed in sync with code.

For the full pyds project layout (pixi, tests, CLI), use examples/pyds-init-demo.

docs.title: What we ship
docs.text:
Data science teams create leverage when they agree on technical artifacts they deliver consistently.

Examples attendees named in Part 1:

  • Versioned Python packages
  • CLIs on shared compute
  • Published documentation
  • APIs and internal tools

This page is intentionally short — it's a sample doc page beyond the README, used to show the edit → rebuild cycle in Demo 2.

Try it: add your team's artifact types below during follow-along.
